tool.name: Risk Intelligence
tool.question: Are there verified risk events or stress conditions in crypto right now, and how has that changed?

public_api.key_issuance: Free keys on request via the feedback form at https://risk.aribresearch.com/feedback

endpoints.summary: Current label, score, coverage and module status
Per-module detail: severities, contributing items, peg deviations, exchange flows
Recorded events of the last 30 days (module, since, min_points, limit, cursor)
Forward-record snapshots of the last 30 days (days, limit, cursor)
Data sources and their current health

datasets.description: Current state label, 0-100 risk score (null below 50% coverage), coverage, per-module status and severity.
datasets.redistribution: not permitted in bulk; quote individual items with credit
datasets.attribution: AriB Research · Risk Intelligence. Underlying data: DefiLlama, SEC, CFTC, OFAC Sanctions List Service, UK FCA (see each item's source link).
datasets.license_note: Personal and internal use. Do not resell or redistribute bulk data. Credit AriB Research (Risk Intelligence) and the original sources.
